items.title: How Cheech & Chong Reunited After 20 Years
items.body_excerpt: FULL EP: https://youtu.be/fl41i2q_m3w?si=I4jA5Kc6jP0fM-td The legendary story of Cheech & Chong's breakup and miraculous reunion — Chong's son secretly intercepted an email and wrote back pretending to be his dad, which is how the duo got back together after 20 years apart.
